high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for an event titled "Unity Through Dialogue." The event features an open conversation with Vivek Ramaswamy, scheduled for Thursday, September 19th, from 6:30 p.m. to 8 p.m. at the Edward Wren Room in the Bushnell Events Center, located at 22 N Fountain Ave, Springfield, OH 45502. The poster has a clean and professional design with a white background and red and blue accents that evoke a sense of unity and patriotism. At the top, the phrase "UNITY THROUGH DIALOGUE" is prominently displayed
